prompt:
Create ONE revised visual reference for this Chinese game's dungeon exploration screen. Edit the attached CURRENT PRODUCT DESIGN as the authoritative reference. Combine its Cold Steel Archive UI rules with the exploration clarity and oppressive environmental atmosphere associated with Darkest Dungeon ONE. This is an ORIGINAL hybrid design, not a replica of Darkest Dungeon's actual HUD, artwork, characters or typography. Deliver one high-fidelity1672x941 full-screen concept, no collage, no annotations.

The agreed design direction is: Cold Steel controls/typography/materials, stronger gothic environmental storytelling, and a simple ROOM-AND-CONNECTION map with clear unknown/known/selected states. Make these changes VISIBLY meaningful, not just another recolor of the supplied screenshot.

HARD PRESERVATIONS:
- Inset lower central planning console with broad empty LEFT gutter for original party panels and narrower empty RIGHT gutter for existing shortcut buttons. Console roughly x290..1490. Keep these gutters empty dark scenery, do not invent replacements.
- Dark gradient smoked-black frosted glass background, charcoal layering, off-white text, small blue/cyan accents, danger red only for risk and loss.
- Main "进入节点" button remains LARGE in the MIDDLE AREA of the bottom dock; both exits remain SMALLER and STACKED ON THE RIGHT.
- All five expected-reward categories, invasion status, route controls and node dossier remain inside the lower console.
- Keep the actual game's systems: NO torch-resource bar, stress meter, sanity gauge, food/supply system, walking party strip, new portraits, invented mechanics or resource costs.
- No route overlays on painted castle roads. No photo-recognition/planned-background system. The schematic is independent of scenery.
- Chinese fonts must be clean Microsoft YaHei UI-style sans-serif, tabular Consolas-style numbers. No serif/brush/medieval decorative lettering.

1) REBALANCE SCENERY AND UI:
Make the upper environment about32-34% of the image height, not the cramped20% strip in the supplied reference. Lower central console begins around y310, extends to~926. Keep the same moonlit castle theme, skull/candle vignette left and raven right, but give the castle gateway, stairs and depths more room. Strengthen directional lighting: warm candle foreground, cold moonlit approach, deep door shadows. Add subtle atmospheric mist and strong shadow masses; slight etched/illustrative definition rather than glossy surfaces. It should suggest danger behind the gate. No characters or new major objects. Integrate console with scenery through a soft dark fade, not enormous metallic hardware.

2) PLANNING CONSOLE HEADER (~310..365):
One restrained integrated header with "探索规划", smaller "恐怖地牢 · D级", "探索进度 0 / 45". Right side compact "时空特工入侵" "0%" "尚未开始判定". Tiny subdued meter only if it fits. Keep one fine silver rim and sparse cyan tick, not boxed mini-panels.
Smoked-black glass is heavily tinted, around90% opaque in appearance, diffuse low-contrast gradient with charcoal bands. Anything behind it is fully blurred; no identifiable scenery edges behind text/paths.

3) MAIN MAP AND DOSSIER (~370..665):
Left~72% width route map remains LARGE and readable, not relegated to a tiny corner minimap. Right~28% is concise node dossier.
MAP REDESIGN:
Replace the chunky 3D metallic hexagon medals with simple lightweight ROOM MARKERS: compact square/cut-corner dark tiles with one thin silver outline, around40-46px, flat legible silver symbols. Start is a gate, combat clean crossed blades, elite a simple angular horn-mask, reward a lockbox, unknown a question mark. No sculpted skulls, shiny coin rims or multiple nested borders. These should read as map rooms rather than equipment badges.
Arrange four ordered branching lanes, roughly12-14 visible nodes and generous spacing, mild stagger, unobstructed clean connecting segments. Connections evoke corridors through precise straight runs and short clean bends, with NO crossings or tangled diagonals. Do not fill corridors with repeated boxes that could be mistaken for extra playable rooms.
Current start at left: thin cyan outer outline and a small clear position pointer, label "当前位置". Directly adjacent selected elite room: cyan boundary and label "可前往". Only their direct connection is bright cyan. Other currently adjacent room links subdued solid silver. Remote unknown links dashed low contrast, unrevealed room types use subdued question markers, not detailed spoilers. Keep clear hierarchy of near/known vs distant/unknown without hiding visible topology. Do not make all nodes bright or add a continuous highlighted chain through multiple rooms.
Small controls "路线总览" and "当前位置" at top-right of map. Keep the map bed matte near-black, no parchment, false geographic texture, decorative circuitry or irrelevant grid. Very light darkness falloff toward unexplored edge is enough.
DOSSIER REDESIGN:
Heading "节点档案". A small, low-contrast ORIGINAL atmospheric vignette of the selected shadowy stone doorway, approx230x60px, integrated into the top of the dossier without its own thick frame. It illustrates setting only, not revealed monsters or rewards.
Below: compact matching elite symbol alongside "精英遭遇", secondary "可前往".
One concise FLAVOR line "门后传来沉重的脚步声。"
Two tight aligned info rows "风险" / "较高" (muted red) and "收益" / "较高" (white).
Small practical note "准备充分后再前往".
This replaces the giant duplicated skull crest with useful exploration context. Keep this column readable and calm, no extra fake enemy stats/probabilities.

4) EXPECTED REWARDS (~675..784):
A slim charcoal band across the INNER console width, fine separator above, no row of thick cards.
Title "预期收益" with note "地牢规则预览 · 非已获得".
Five compact categories, text-first, tiny understated silver icons only:
"首领金币" / "5,500–6,500"
"通关金币" / "5,000 起"
"竞技场宝箱" / "75% · 1,800金" / "强化石1 / 重铸券1必得"
"精英附加" / "优质装备 · 50%"
"祭品范围" / "普通—传说"
Use extra width for chest details, no hidden/removed category or fictional guaranteed total. These describe dungeon reward rules, not loot already secured.

5) ACTION DOCK (~790..919):
Large CENTER "进入节点" button with dark desaturated steel-blue surface, thin cyan edge, white20px-ish label and small arrow. Maintain its role as the hero action. No overblown glow or solid electric-blue fill.
RIGHT compact stacked exits:
"安全撤离" with "仅起点可用 · 保留战利品", tiny safe-green dot.
"强制放弃" with warm-red "丢失背包全部物品" and "需二次确认".
Keep both warnings fully legible and inside frame. No duplicate buttons, no move of exits into reserved side gutters. Quiet left part of dock may remain empty.

OVERALL LOOK:
Stronger exploration atmosphere above; room-map simplicity and uncertainty in center; cold-steel readability and familiar actions below. The lower UI stays restrained and modern, while scenery/doorway vignette carry the dark gothic character. Palette dominated by near-black/charcoal, silver labels, sparse blue/cyan interactions, warm danger only as semantic accents. Use tonal hierarchy, spacing and a few thin dividers instead of metal cages. All Chinese text crisp and accurately spelled, body~14-16px, titles~20px, notes~12px. Avoid unnecessary extra icons, features, framing and exaggerated textures.

context.inspiration: Previously agreed Darkest Dungeon 1 exploration principles: stronger environmental presentation, lightweight room map, known/unknown states, and risk/reward context. No actual third-party screenshot attached or cloned.

changes: Lighter cut-corner room markers and clearer connections
Compact doorway vignette and illustrative flavor text in node dossier
Existing middle main action, right exits, rewards and invasion retained
limitations: Flavor sentence and doorway vignette are illustrative content, not existing revealed gameplay facts.
Raster spacing, margins and typography are approximate; final implementation must retain original HUD sizes and left274/right104 safe-area requirements.
No new stress/torch/supply mechanics or modifications to reachability/reward/invasion/evacuation rules.
No code/config/official assets changed, no tests or runtime verification.
